audit: Phase 1 full review — implementation vs Nightclub v4.0 package + SWE2MAX scope

findings.detail: booking checkout payments are inserted with order_id=NULL; the webhook then tries to confirm the booking via `bookings.id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM sales_orders WHERE id = payment.order_id)` which can never match, so a successful webhook leaves the booking PAYMENT_PENDING forever. Separately, `UPDATE table_allocations ... WHERE event_id AND status='HELD'` has no booking_id filter, so one successful deposit confirms EVERY held allocation in the event (cross-booking contamination).
findings.remediation: store booking_id on the payment row (or a payment_bookings link), confirm exactly that booking and only its allocations; add regression test
findings.fix: fixed: checkout creates VIP sales_order+line+payment (order_id linked); webhook resolves tenant via system-lookup policy, dedups via integration_events ON CONFLICT, confirms only that booking + its allocations; regression tests/api/vip.test.ts

findings.detail: joins `ae.visit_id = v.visit_id`; visits has no visit_id column so the query raises an error and the endpoint 500s (untested path).
findings.remediation: join ae.visit_id = v.id; add test

findings.detail: status transition does not increment version; optimistic concurrency on the row is stale afterwards.
findings.remediation: add version=version+1; test finalize-then-refinalize

findings.detail: new table_allocation.status is copied verbatim from bookings.status; for a PAYMENT_PENDING booking this inserts 'PAYMENT_PENDING' into a CHECK-constrained enum and produces a 500 instead of a controlled result.
findings.remediation: map booking status -> allocation status (HOLD->HELD, CONFIRMED->CONFIRMED, PAYMENT_PENDING->HELD); test
findings.fix: fixed: allocation status mapped via CASE (CONFIRMED->CONFIRMED else HELD)

findings.detail: a receipt row stuck in PROCESSING (handler crashed after insert) blocks the same idempotency key until the 24h TTL because expires_at is never consulted on the conflict path.
findings.remediation: on conflict, if status='PROCESSING' and expires_at < now, delete/reclaim the receipt row
findings.fix: fixed: expired receipts reclaimed (delete+retry) in withReceipt/platformReceipt

findings.detail: CSV escaper quotes but does not neutralize spreadsheet formula injection (=, +, -, @, TAB, CR leading chars). Master prompt and security_and_operations.md require CSV sanitization.
findings.remediation: prefix dangerous leading characters with a single quote; add unit test
findings.fix: fixed: CSV cells escaped for quotes/CR/LF + formula-injection tab prefix

findings.detail: request bodies are cast with TypeScript `as` assertions only — no runtime schema validation (master prompt: runtime schemas required, TS assertions do not count).
findings.remediation: add Fastify `schema` option (bundled ajv) per route for body/params/query

findings.detail: no Origin/Fetch-Metadata/CSRF enforcement on state-changing cookie-authenticated requests; no security headers.
findings.remediation: add onRequest guard: POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE require same-site (Sec-Fetch-Site) or allowed Origin; add baseline security headers

findings.detail: no application rate limiting on /auth/dev/login, /device/enroll, invitation accept, ticket redeem, customer search (PIN has DB lockout only).
findings.remediation: in-memory token-bucket hook for sensitive endpoints; document multi-instance limitation

findings.detail: reply.raw.write can throw after the client disconnects (write is outside try); also reopens a transaction per poll.
findings.remediation: guard writes with closed flag + try/catch
findings.fix: fixed: SSE honors Last-Event-ID and emits id: per changed event

findings.detail: no GET /stores/:id/roles — roles and their permissions cannot be listed, although PUT /roles/:id exists.
findings.remediation: add list endpoint + permissions

findings.detail: no endpoint to (re)assign roles to a membership — invitation assigns once; role changes impossible except by editing the role itself.
findings.remediation: add PUT /memberships/:id/roles

findings.detail: notification_jobs has no member-facing read/ack surface; IN_APP channel is write-only.
findings.remediation: add GET /me/notifications + ack endpoint (migration for read state)

findings.detail: no event-scoped orders list; only single-order GET.
findings.remediation: add GET /stores/:id/events/:eid/orders

findings.detail: no additional-party/segment endpoint on an existing visit (追加人数の再判定) and no visit_members management for companions.
findings.remediation: add POST visits/:id/segments (re-judged) + members add/remove

findings.detail: no kiosk lookup for a pass by token/id for re-entry scanning; passes only surface inside visit summaries.
findings.remediation: add GET events/:id/passes?token= or list per visit

findings.detail: no event update/cancel/duplicate endpoints (duplication is an explicit scope item).
findings.remediation: add PATCH event, POST /events/:id/duplicate, POST /events/:id/cancel

findings.detail: no unauthenticated public booking surface (公開予約フォーム).
findings.remediation: booking_pages table + public GET/POST endpoints (rate limited) creating APPROVAL_PENDING bookings

findings.detail: no quotations model and no private-event detail flow (貸切/見積).
findings.remediation: migration: quotations table + endpoints; booking quotation link

findings.detail: N+1 visitSummary per visit inside snapshot.
findings.remediation: batch load or document acceptable size cap

findings.detail: no CSP/X-Content-Type-Options/Referrer-Policy headers on API.
findings.remediation: onSend hook baseline headers

findings.detail: no POST /platform/tenants/:id/stores or store-scoped create; onboarding item store_created cannot complete via API.
findings.remediation: add platform store create + tenant admin bootstrap

findings.detail: no email-link login, no TOTP/recovery MFA, LINE OIDC is a 501 stub (B-02 gated).
findings.remediation: email-link token flow (dev outbox) + TOTP enroll/verify + recovery codes; OIDC adapter interface kept behind config

findings.detail: no platform-operator management/list endpoint.
findings.remediation: GET/POST /platform/operators

findings.detail: reward_rules + settlement lines exist, but no statements/disputes/payout lifecycle (EP17 scope).
findings.remediation: migration + endpoints: reward_statements, reward_disputes, payout marks

findings.detail: spec/current/openapi.yaml is the v4 *designed* contract, not the implemented surface; no mechanical route/contract comparison.
findings.remediation: rewrite spec to implemented surface + parity test

findings.detail: no staff lookup of issued tickets by order for reprint/lost-token handling; token returned only at issuance (by design) so UI must capture it immediately.
findings.remediation: UI captures tokens at creation; add per-instance revoke/reissue endpoints

findings.detail: events.ts ends with `void requireOperator` hack; finance.ts param destructure lists every param name as a workaround.
findings.remediation: type route params properly

findings.detail: unimplemented scope items: tenant import/migration jobs, branding, deletion-execution job, floor-map 2D editor UI, ticket QR UI, POS/inventory UI, CRM/campaigns, analytics/forecasting, multilingual/multicurrency beyond column, Stripe/Square/freee adapters, LINE OIDC, real WebPush/SES, platform console UI, role help/onboarding UI, PWA update flow, a11y pass.
findings.remediation: implement per phase; external-credential items stay BLOCKED with adapter seams
